title: Data Pipelines: Schedule Runs and Read the History | Orchard Core
description:
A data pipeline that someone must start by hand depends on that person remembering to do it, and when a run goes wrong, you need to know what it did.

A workflow with a Timer Event and a Run Data Pipeline Task runs a published pipeline on a schedule. The run history lists every run, with its status, its version, what started it, each step, what it delivered, and the error of a run that failed.

In this video:
• How a run works: the published version, the background, and one run at a time
• Starting a run from the list of pipelines
• Scheduling a pipeline with a Timer Event and a Run Data Pipeline Task
• Reading the run history: statuses, filters, steps, the log and what a run delivered
• Cancelling runs, and how long the history is kept
